pull.title: KAFKA-16200: Enforce that RequestManager implementations respect user-provided timeout
pull.body:
The intention of the CompletableApplicationEvent is for a Consumer to block waiting for the event to complete. The application thread will block for the timeout, but there is not yet a consistent manner in which events are timed out.

Enforce at the request manager layer that timeouts are respected per the design in [KAFKA-15848](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-15848).
